plain: The length of task, measured by how long it takes a skilled human, that an AI agent can finish about half the time.
eli5: The longest chore a robot can usually finish by itself, counted in how long a grown-up would take.
technical: METR's 50% (or 80%) task-completion time horizon: the human expert completion time at which a fitted logistic curve of agent success against log task length crosses 50% (or 80%); it has doubled roughly every seven months.
